corrections: Ripple Treasury's $13T 2025 payment volume is confirmed by its own April1 2026 announcement; it is a PRIMARY_COMPANY_STATEMENT, not merely a secondary claim.

Ripple Treasury launched native digital-asset capabilities on April1 2026. Its Digital Account Management supports regulated Ripple-native digital asset accounts and displays XRP and RLUSD balances alongside cash.
The $13T payment volume refers to 2025, before those native digital-asset capabilities were launched. It is not evidence that $13T settled on-chain or in XRP/RLUSD.
The platform's future expansion into cross-border/intercompany settlement and 24/7 repo was described as forthcoming; actual production status and volume are unknown.
executive_findings: Ripple Treasury's $13T 2025 payments volume is now verified as a primary company-reported metric from Ripple Treasury's April1 2026 launch announcement.

Ripple Treasury directly supports institutional management/visibility of XRP and RLUSD balances within a regulated Ripple-native digital-asset account. This is a direct product capability and access pathway, not proof of customer XRP holdings or payment use.
Because the $13T relates to 2025 and native digital-asset capabilities launched in April2026, the $13T must not be treated as XRP or stablecoin settlement volume.
Future cross-border/intercompany settlement and 24/7 yield through overnight repo were described as forthcoming, not verified live.
The prior escrow, SBI Remit, BNY custody, Coinbase RLUSD and ETF-flow findings remain unchanged.
